name: locus_call
description: Call a free Locus tool by name with JSON arguments. Use this for no-charge coverage checks, lane availability, parcel facts, source-card provenance, citation verification, and other bounded local-context reads. This endpoint does not return paid briefs or full paid reports; buy the x402/MPP endpoints only after a free preflight says there is substance here. CALL FORMAT: The free /tools/call endpoint requires a WRAPPED body: {"name": "<tool>", "arguments": { ... }}. Tool inputs go inside `arguments`, NOT at the top level. Paid /api/<slug> routes are the opposite (flat body). Pick `name` from the locus_list catalog and pass that tool's input object as `arguments`. Free — no payment required ($0); this server never charges for it. Cost: ~$0/call [spec].

arguments.description: That free tool's input object; per-tool input schemas come from the locus_list catalog.

name.description: A free tool name from the locus_list catalog.

name: locus_list

Full briefs and full reports remain x402/MPP-paid. Use ?compact=1 for a small name/title/description/category/coverageScope catalog, and ?category=<cat> to filter by compact/full category. Free — no payment required ($0); this server never charges for it. Cost: ~$0/call [spec].
